title: worktree-proof — one real task, in one worktree, reachable through the proxy, then removed

set.request: worktree-proof: node Server/worktree-up.mjs proof-1 - up time and size vs 3.1s/274MB; through the proxy at proof-1.localhost:8080/framework/ or prove why not and log the Servex gap; a real task inside it (days-view headline+link fix in public/framework/ai/v/3/) committed only in the worktree; cherry-pick behind the reload hold into the uncommitted main tree; node Server/worktree-down.mjs proof-1 with the numbers; a page.js report with the six numbers, two shots, one paragraph on hand vs one-command
steps: read briefs and existing worktree-up/down + Servex code
worktree-up.mjs proof-1 - log wall time and disk size vs 3.1s/274MB
proxy reachability - try to register with Servex, else prove direct port and log the exact gap
real task inside the worktree - days-view headline+link fix, shot at 1280 and 400, commit in worktree only
bring it home - cherry-pick behind the reload hold, prove headless on :8099
worktree-down.mjs proof-1 - prove cleanup, log total cycle time
build the report page and link it from ai/2026-09-22/page.js
set.outcome: **A worktree built a real fix, proved the proxy has a gap, and tore itself down clean — worktree-design's own numbers held almost exactly.** Up: about 5.3s once `npm ci`'s Windows bug (EINVAL, missing `shell: true`) is worked around by hand — 3.1s to create the worktree, matching worktree-design's own number exactly. Size: 278 MB (274 MB checkout plus 3.7 MB node_modules), matching worktree-design's measured 274 MB almost exactly. Proxy: not reachable yet — Servex has no way to learn a new worktree's port without a Server/Servex code change outside this task's fence, so it's proved on the direct port instead: 200, zero console errors, and the one route Servex actually needs is logged on this task. Real task: fixed and headless-proven at 1280 and 400 — days-view rows now lead with the bold task name and a still-running row is no longer a link — committed inside the worktree only. Brought home: `git cherry-pick` refused outright because the main tree already carries the feature uncommitted, so the one commit's diff landed as a plain patch instead, proven with zero console errors on a private server. Down: 1089ms, and all four cleanup claims (worktree list, branch, directory, registry entry) verified by direct inspection, not by trusting the script's own printed output. ![the fixed days view at 1280](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/worktree-proof/shots/days-1280.png) [Report page](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/worktree-proof/) - [worktree-design](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/worktree-design/) - [days-view](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/days-view/) - [v/3/page.js](/framework/ai/v/3/page.js). Left as findings rather than fixes, because Server/ and Servex/ are outside this task's fence: the `npm ci` EINVAL bug in worktree-up.mjs, a worktree's blindness to the main tree's own uncommitted files (this repo's main tree is never committed), and the one Servex route or MCP tool that would make a worktree reachable through the proxy with no restart.
